data.cultural_impact: The name Rajarth implies a high social status, power, and influence in Indian society. The title 'Raj' symbolizes royalty, leadership, and authority. The suffix 'Arth' signifies prosperity and wealth, which could mean physical wealth, or the wealth of knowledge, wisdom, or virtues. The name reflects a\]wom-wner's ambition, drive, and confidence. It is a name that commands respect and admiration in traditional Indian culture.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hindu spirituality, the name Rajarth can represent the inner king, the 'Atman', who seeks to rule over the material desires and worldly attachments, thereby attaining spiritual wealth. The name can also represent the pursuit of Kama (desire or passion) and Artha (Prosperity), which are considered essential aspects of human life in Hindu philosophy. The ultimate goal, however, is winning the battle against Kama and Artha and achieving Moksha or spiritual liberation. The name can serve as a reminder of one's inner potential as a king, ruling over both the material and spiritual worlds.

historical_references.reference: Rajaratha was the name of an ancient Indian kingdom located in present-day Rajasthan. It is believed to have been ruled by the Rajputs from the 8th to the 13th centuries CE. The city of Amber was the capital of this kingdom.
historical_references.context: Ancient Indian kingdom in Rajasthan ruled by the Rajputs

historical_references.reference: Another reference to Rajaratha can be found in the epic Mahabharata, where it is mentioned as the capital of the kingdom of Haihayas, ruled by Bhagadatta. This reference dates back to around the 4th century BCE.
historical_references.context: Capital city of the kingdom of Haihayas mentioned in Mahabharata
